headline: Diesel passes 1.90 euro, inflation rising... What is the government doing?
summary: E-Vesti reports diesel above 1.90 euro and rising inflation. It says the government developed baseline, bad and systemic economic scenarios with business measures and rejected helicopter money.
why: Diesel prices and inflation shape household purchasing power, transport costs and central bank thinking on rates. Government fiscal responses influence business conditions.
